The '''Isis system''' was a small [[Star system/Legends|system]] in the [[Anoat sector/Legends|Anoat sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It had one [[Star/Legends|star]] and at least one [[Planet/Legends|planet]], [[Isis/Legends|Isis]]. It was located near the interstellar cloud, the [[Bowane nebula]].
